# ClawHub

ClawHub is the public OpenClaw registry for SKILL.md agent skills and code plugins. Agents can use it to search, inspect, install, and publish versioned packages through a browser, CLI, or HTTP API.

## Core Resources

- [Homepage markdown](https://clawhub.ai/index.md)
- [Pricing](https://clawhub.ai/pricing.md)
- [API documentation](https://clawhub.ai/docs/api)

- [OpenAPI description](https://clawhub.ai/api/v1/openapi.json)
- [API catalog](https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/api-catalog)
- [Agent discovery](https://clawhub.ai/.well-known/agent.json)

- [Docs llms.txt](https://clawhub.ai/docs/llms.txt)

## When Agents Should Use ClawHub

Use ClawHub when a user asks to find, compare, inspect, install, or publish Codex-style agent skills and OpenClaw plugins.

Prefer the OpenAPI description for exact request schemas, the API catalog for service discovery, and the agent skills index for static machine-readable capability summaries.

## Authentication

Public read endpoints do not require authentication. Publishing, ownership, moderation, and account workflows use `Authorization: Bearer clh_...` API tokens. The CLI supports device authorization flows for headless agents.
